audio.author: Za-Games (one flint strike, Freesound 539973, CC0); sequenced into a knapping session by 20watts (scripts/dev/knapping.mjs)
audio.performers: Stone on stone: a hammerstone striking flint, the blows of a hand axe being shaped. Not a recording of a knapper at work: one real strike, repeated the way knapping goes.
audio.notes: There is no free recording of flint knapping (Freesound, Commons and the Crabtree collection at Idaho were checked on 2026-10-18; the Crabtree films are not free). The nearest thing was a single 0.6 s strike of stone on stone released CC0 on Freesound by Za-Games ('A short sound of stones being struck together that could be used for flint knapping'). scripts/dev/knapping.mjs downloads it, trims the leading silence, and lays 48 seconds of blows: runs of two to six, each at a random gain between 0.35 and 1 and a random playback rate between 0.85 and 1.25, 0.45-1.1 s apart, with 1.2-3 s pauses between runs for turning the core. The sequence is seeded, so the file is the same every time. The 'hq' preview (128 kbit/s mp3) is what Freesound serves without a login; the original is a wav of the same take. Played in a loop at the hand axe so that the first work on the lane has the sound of its own making.
